analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about configuring a [product_name] to monitor internet connectivity by pinging an IP address and activating a digital output upon loss of connection. The response explained that such monitoring is limited to interactions with specific partner devices, implying that general internet IP-based watchdog functionality may not be supported by default.
